content:
{
  "phoneNote": "The automotive styling is distinctive, but the dark, tightly cropped hero photo and repeated contact areas weaken an otherwise readable mobile page.",
  "desktopNote": "The oversized headline and number-plate CTA dominate the first screen, obscuring the workshop photo and pushing the location below the fold.",
  "phone": {
    "impression": 3,
    "hierarchy": 3,
    "imagery": 3,
    "spacing": 4,
    "clutter": 2,
    "distinctiveness": 4
  },
  "desktop": {
    "impression": 3,
    "hierarchy": 2,
    "imagery": 3,
    "spacing": 3,
    "clutter": 3,
    "distinctiveness": 4
  },
  "fixes": [
    "Reduce the desktop hero headline and number-plate CTA, bring the location into the first screen, and give the workshop photo a clearer, less darkened area on both viewports.",
    "Consolidate the address, hours and contact details into one closing contact section; keep the footer focused on legal information rather than repeating that section.",
    "Tighten desktop section heights and top-align the year and specialist information to remove the large empty area above “2012”."
  ],
  "blockers": [
    "Phone and desktop full-page views: the white navigation header overlays and obscures hero text.",
    "Phone closing sections: the yellow contact block is immediately followed by another block repeating the address, directions and opening hours."
  ]
}
